{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Wrap cocktail dress with a V-neckline, flutter sleeves, a defined waist and a full flared skirt, midi length just below the knee, in vivid fuchsia #D6246E, satin-finish crepe

Ankle-strap sandals with a block heel, open toe, in warm gold #C9A24B, smooth leather

Structured envelope clutch, small, with a gold clasp, in antique gold #D4AF37, metallic leather

Sculptural drop earrings, long and curved, in polished gold #D4AF37, gold-plated brass

Wide open cuff bracelet, slim and smooth, in polished gold #D4AF37, gold-plated brass

This outfit brings a saturated fuchsia that glows against your deep skin and dark hair, so you stand out in every photo without wearing anything near white. The wrap cut with a nipped waist and a flowing skirt moves beautifully, and the lightweight crepe keeps you cool through an August ceremony outdoors. A cocktail dress with heeled sandals fits the smart dress band for a wedding, and the block heel stays steady on grass. The gold accessories add a warm, polished finish and carry you from the ceremony to the restaurant without any change."}
